verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: a stray black rule cuts through 'MODERN' in the headline, the red panel runs off the bottom edge with a large dead red area under the text, and the skyline, the key image, is shrunk into a small box on the right, so the layered city-over-quote feel is gone. B keeps the original composition and brand intact, but it is just the original shrunk and centred between wide empty grey bars, so the headline and attribution text is small and the banner shape is wasted, not rearranged.
